_about: Cards drafted from each tool's own contract (tools/tool_card_author.py, reviewed).

token.research.use_when: The person wants to look into a crypto coin or contract: its basics, biggest holders, who created it, whether it can still be minted or frozen, what else the creator launched, its links, or who posted about it first.
examples: research this token for me, the contract is on solana
who deployed this coin? can they still mint more of it
what else did the dev launch
check the top holders of this contract on base, is it concentrated?
is this a rug? look at the creator and the holders
pls check if mint authority or freeze authority is still active on this one
who posted about $WIF first on social media
show me the website and socials listed for this token
wat other coins has this creator wallet made, bnb chain
research this ca on ethereum, keep it short
Investiga este token de Solana: quién lo creó y quiénes son los mayores holders
Peux-tu vérifier qui a créé ce jeton et s'il peut encore en créer d'autres ?
Wer hält die meisten Coins von diesem Token und wer hat ihn erstellt?
Ištirk šį žetoną: kas jį sukūrė ir kokie yra didžiausi jo turėtojai?
not_for: how do I read a holder distribution chart?
explain what a mint authority is
write a post hyping my new coin
what do you think about crypto in general?
how do I launch my own token on Solana?
buy 100 dollars of this coin for me
